notes.ml: The ml section needs the canonical team model models/isoforest.joblib with sha256 ml_model_sha256 (git-ignored; aegis train stamps a creation time, so a retrain never reproduces it). Without it the ML cases skip, as in CI.
notes.strict: Bit-exact layers are compared only with AEGIS_GOLDEN_STRICT=1, meant for the host that recorded the section (recorded_env). A matching OS / Python / library set is not enough: on a second Windows CPython 3.13 host (3.13.15) the frame digest of 4 ML-off cases differs with numpy 2.5.3, 2.5.4 and 2.5.5.
